entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Hall Yale was a Minnesota lawyer and Republican politician who served as Senator and the sixth lieutenant governor of Minnesota. He was made regent of the University of Minnesota in 1894 by Governor Nelson, and was a member of the Episcopal Church.
